def solve(I):
    N=len(I); H=N
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    # main-diag families; fill via repeated +h steps starting from each seed
    h=N//2
    seen=set()
    for r in range(N):
        for c in range(N):
            if I[r][c]:
                d=(r-c)%N
                if d in seen: continue
                v=I[r][c]; chain=[]
                cur=d; seen.add(d)
                while True:
                    nxt=(cur+h)%N
                    if nxt==d: break
                    if nxt in seen: break
                    seen.add(nxt); chain.append(nxt); cur=nxt
                for rr in range(N):
                    for cc in range(N):
                        if (rr-cc)%N in chain+[d]: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
print('D1 ok', solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
P2=solve(G['Demo pair 2 input'])
